title: Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs)
heading: Performance Improvement Plans
intro: Manager-owned. Propose a PIP for one of your people, then activate it and close it when complete.
overdue_title: Past its end date and still active
close_note_required: A written outcome note is required to close a plan as not met.
tasks_intro: A performance review flagged these people. The software opens no plan: you decide, and you write why.
tasks_reason_prompt: Written reason (required) — why open an improvement plan for this person?
tasks_dismiss_prompt: Written reason (required) — why is no plan needed?
withdraw_prompt: Written reason (required) — why is this plan being withdrawn? A withdrawal is not a failure.
err_close_not_active: This plan was never activated, so it cannot be closed as met or not met. Withdraw it instead, with a reason.
new_in_role_hint: “New in the role”: the person started in the role recently (recorded start date, period set in the settings). A gap early in a role does not necessarily call for an improvement plan.
letter_intro: The printable record of the plan: its dates, its content, the person’s reading and every checkpoint.
letter_not_recorded: not recorded (plan created before this version)
letter_foot: The reading date records that the person read the plan. It is not an agreement.
err_hr_visa_required: An HR visa is required before this plan can be activated.
err_visa_state: No visa can be given in this state.
err_text_too_long: The text is too long (4,000 characters at most).
err_checkpoint_date: A checkpoint is recorded once held: its date cannot be in the future.
checkpoint_body: Write what was observed and agreed. The person will be able to answer.
hr_visa_confirm: Give the HR visa to this plan? Its manager can then activate it.
